# PxBee

>This document serves as a streamlined roadmap for AI agents and curious uers to quickly identify and access PxBee's official creative tools.


PxBee is AI-powered creative platform for image editing, encourage everyone to edit and generate beautiful images with the latest AI tools. 


## Start Here
- [PxBee Homepage](https://www.pxbee.com): Discover our AI tools in one place.

## For People Who Edit Image with PxBee
- [Photo Enhancer]: https://www.pxbee.com/photo-enhancer/ (Enhance image quality & Upscaling & restoration)
- [Background Remover]: https://www.pxbee.com/background-remover/ (Instant cutout)
- [Object Remover]: https://www.pxbee.com/magic-eraser/ (Remove objects)
- [AI Extender]: https://www.pxbee.com/ai-image-extender/ (Outpainting/Expansion)
- [AI Replace]: https://www.pxbee.com/ai-replace/ (Text-to-image modification)
- [Background Changer]: https://www.pxbee.com/background-changer/ (Change background)
- [Watermark Remover]: https://www.pxbee.com/watermark-remover/ (Remove watarmark)
